title: Buckwheat Blini
description: Yeast-raised buckwheat pancakes, left to ferment overnight so they come out sour and lacy rather than sweet. Served with sour cream and whatever is salty.
notes: The overnight rise is the flavour. A one-hour version works and tastes like a plain pancake.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: melted, plus more for the pan

steps.text: Whisk the buckwheat flour, all-purpose flour, instant yeast, and warm milk into a loose batter.
Cover and leave at room temperature to ferment.
steps.tip: It should smell distinctly sour in the morning and be covered in bubbles.

steps.text: Beat in the egg yolks, salt, and melted butter.
Whip the egg whites to soft peaks and fold them through.
steps.tip: Fold, do not stir. The air is what makes them lacy.

steps.text: Cook spoonfuls in a buttered pan over a medium heat until the surface is covered in holes, then turn.
